typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Trade ID} as string,
		{Field Amended} as string,
		{New Field Mapping} as string,
		{Ignore Reason} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Field_Amended as string,
		Create_Dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TradeID as string,
		Ignore_Reason as string,
		Field_Mapping as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Field_Amended = {Field Amended},
		Create_Dte = LoadDate,
		TradeID = {Trade ID},
		Ignore_Reason = {Ignore Reason},
		Field_Mapping = {New Field Mapping}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
